description: This PHP file defines the AttendanceReport class within the OrangeHRM system. It implements report generation for employee attendance, including filter preparation, validation rules, header definition, and data retrieval logic. The class utilizes traits for user role management, text helpers, and internationalization, and handles report access permissions.

classes.name: AttendanceReport
classes.description: Class responsible for generating and managing attendance reports, including filter handling, validation, header definition, and permission checks within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares filter parameters from the request, including employee numbers, job title, subunit, employment status, and date range.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for request parameters, ensuring correct entity IDs and date formats, including cross-field date validation.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the report header layout, including column names and sizes, for the attendance report.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Provides the filter options available for the report, currently an empty filter object.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on the provided filter parameters, returning an AttendanceReportData object.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has permission to access the report, throws ForbiddenException if access is denied.
